[ITST.10.4] **Every line and branch figure is held by a two-sided floor.**
Each figure has a floor, a percentage, and every floor has a slack of one
percentage point. A measurement must fail when a figure is below its floor,
and must fail when a figure is at or above its floor plus the slack; it then
names the floor the figure gives, which is the figure less half the slack. A
figure the measurement does not produce must fail it as a breach does.

A floor must be set only to a value a measurement named. A figure's first
floor is the one its first measurement names. A change
that lowers a floor must say why.
